stem: A preschool has a rectangular field and a rectangular playground that are similar in shape. Each dimension of the field is 3.2 times the corresponding dimension of the playground. Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The area of the field is 6.4 times the area of the playground.

options.label: B
options.text: The area of the field is 10.24 times the area of the playground.

options.label: C
options.text: The perimeter of the field is 6.4 times the perimeter of the playground.

options.label: D
options.text: The perimeter of the field is 10.24 times the perimeter of the playground.
